在 westd 上创建 `/root/contamcal-irt-calibration/exp001/run_eval_14b_batch.sh`：

```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -e

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
export HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1

MODEL_PATH="/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-14B"
PYTHON="/root/miniconda3/bin/python3.12"
EVAL_SCRIPT="/root/contamcal-irt-calibration/exp001/evaluate.py"
BASE_CKPT="/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints"
OUTPUT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/eval_results_14b"

mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_BASE"

for DOSE in d000 d005 d025 d050 d100; do
    ADAPTER="${BASE_CKPT}/Qwen2.5-14B_${DOSE}_s42/lora_adapter"
    OUTPUT="${OUTPUT_BASE}/Qwen2.5-14B_${DOSE}_s42"
    
    if [ -f "${OUTPUT}/eval_results.json" ]; then
        echo "=== SKIP ${DOSE} (already done) ==="
        continue
    fi
    
    echo "=== START ${DOSE} at $(date) ==="
    mkdir -p "$OUTPUT"
    
    $PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
        --model-path "$MODEL_PATH" \
        --adapter-path "$ADAPTER" \
        --benchmarks mmlu arc_challenge \
        --mc-format aligned \
        --output-dir "$OUTPUT" \
        --batch-size 1
    
    echo "=== DONE ${DOSE} at $(date) ==="
    
    # 打印结果
    cat "${OUTPUT}/eval_results.json" 2>/dev/null || echo "No results file"
done

echo "=== ALL 14B EVAL COMPLETE at $(date) ==="
touch "${OUTPUT_BASE}/.done"
```
